build_div2k_dataset_builder: build a Div2k dataset builder using tfds.builder_cls('div2k') for image super-resolution
create_div2k_config: create a Div2kConfig with a data option like bicubic_x4 for the DIV2K dataset builder
test_div2k_dataset: test the Div2k dataset builder by generating examples from lr and hr image paths
review_div2k_builder: review the Div2k GeneratorBasedBuilder that downloads and extracts DIV2K dataset splits
summarize_div2k_features: summarize the Div2k dataset features including lr and hr image pairs with supervised_keys
